rules.github_actions: FORBIDDEN: do not create, enable, dispatch, rerun or use workflows; never create .github/workflows/
rules.markdown_layout: Root BRAND.md, CATEGORY.md and ALL-INSTRUMENT.md only, plus README.md and AGENTS.md. No new dated findings, progress parts, RESUME/history Markdown or effects/ documents.
rules.research_priority: Eligible multi-effects found on Shopee Indonesia, plus eligible ever-owned units. Re-search brands and series when saved leads are exhausted.
rules.guitar_scope: Multi-effects only; preserve genuine bass/vocal categories. Dedicated-purpose pedals and FV01 excluded.
rules.specifications: Manufacturer product pages, original manuals, firmware/software documentation. Seller listings support price/availability evidence, not authoritative specifications.
rules.prices: Used/new IDR separately; preserve dates, seller/item, condition, stock, region, bundle, voucher and indexed/direct-access qualifications. No guessed FX or used-price discount.
rules.commit_policy: Commit each researched model before researching another; update relevant views and this ledger. Preserve useful partial findings and explicit unknowns.
rules.merge_policy: Read complete source, preserve every factual qualifier and URL, verify destination before retiring old files. No destructive history rewrite or silent data loss.
rules.privacy: No private receipt/message/order identifiers or payment details in public files. Ownership is separate from specifications and current retention.
